items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Are you speaking of Robin? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah, all the orchestras. We were only coming down to the orchestras in my younger days. And the band I always was crazy about was the Imperial Band...

ctx.x: Oh, when I was a boy, I used to hear the old salsa band, you know. No, I don't know. Oh yeah, and this band Cross the River. Pacific? Pacific band, brass band, you know. The old time band. I was trying to call it the older bands, you know. The Armaged Band, you see. Well, I mean like an orchestra, I see.
Are you speaking of Robin? Any kind of music at all? Grass bands or orchestras? Do you remember some of the early orchestras you heard when you were really young?

Oh yeah, all the orchestras. We were only coming down to the orchestras in my younger days. And the band I always was crazy about was the Imperial Band and the Imperial, what was it? The Imperial Band, yeah. You know? Because, well I was pretty good sized then because I used to a lot of time pinch it for Brown. Oh yes. Used to play bass. James Brown was that his name?
